name: calculator
description: Simple calculator application with basic arithmetic operations

steps.name: Calculator Module
steps.description: Create a Python module with functions for basic arithmetic operations: add, subtract, multiply, divide. Include error handling for division by zero.

steps.name: Calculator Tests
steps.description: Create pytest unit tests for the calculator module, testing all operations including edge cases like division by zero.

steps.name: CLI Interface
steps.description: Create a command-line interface for the calculator using argparse or click. Allow users to specify operation and operands as command-line arguments.
